reasoning: The request parameters are attacker-controlled, but each value is passed through HtmlUtils.htmlEscapeHex before being inserted into the HTML template. This sanitizer converts characters like <, >, &, etc., into numeric character references, effectively neutralizing XSS payloads. The sanitized string is then placed inside a <div> and returned as the HTTP response body. No further processing re‑introduces raw input, so the sink receives only safely escaped content.
